source: Verify criteria and assignment rule share the same group

active = 1 kept from the benchmark check; the request says the rule is in place and directing cases, which needs it active

notes:
disagreement: value: the source of the group requirement: one pass lists the three checks that join on the group's name, the other marks it new; chose the three because each tests the group's name, which only this requirement carries.
disagreement: value: the selector of the stay on Thomas Green: one pass his membership of group 19, the other his membership of any group named US Payroll Tier 2 Support; chose the name-based selector, which holds every row of the other and still catches him if the group is created at another id.
The two passes otherwise agree on every requirement, id, cell and disposition (all five checks kept); their texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
The request names Thomas Green for the group but also says the group is to hold active members, and he is inactive on the seed; the policy's validation rule requires users to be active before processing. The file therefore expects only Tabitha Bullock to be added and Thomas Green to stay out, as the benchmark does. That check holds on the seed only because it forbids an action, so it is carried as a stay rather than counted weak.
The check that the criteria and the rule share a group is a conjunction of their user_group cells and is carried jointly by both, each fixing user_group to the new group 19.
The closing summary of the group, criteria, rule and members is a chat response and leaves no database state, so it has no requirement.
The acting user (Karen Watkins) is an administrator, whom the policy allows to write configuration tables.
